Name: Loosey Goosey
Author: tvriley
Description: This content pack adds a cement goose item that can be purchased from Pierre's shop. It will change appearance based on the weather and day. The goose is not drawn very well, if you think you can do better, feel free to reach out. My wife is from the Midwest and loves concrete garden geese, so I thought I would add one here. Any suggestions welcome.

Downloads.Description: Added new weather condition and changed goose to gray instead of white to better match concrete goose.
